findings.current: Looks like Mimi had learned another Skill while I wasn’t looking.
findings.defect: The draft turns colloquial 스킬 into a discrete, capitalized System Skill and replaces the temporal cue “in the meantime” with an added statement about the narrator not looking.
findings.rationale: Here 스킬 humorously refers to Mimi’s expanding repertoire, not a newly acquired game-system ability.
findings.replacement: Looks like Mimi had picked up some new tricks in the meantime.

findings.current: “You little thunderstruck fool. You certainly made quite a ruckus.”
findings.defect: “Thunderstruck” means astonished or shocked and does not convey 천둥벌거숭이, an idiom for a reckless, unruly youngster.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves Jeok Cheongang’s gruff characterization and the idiom’s intended criticism.
findings.replacement: “You reckless little brat. You certainly made quite a ruckus.”
findings.source: 천둥벌거숭이 같으니. 아주 한바탕 난리를 치더구나.

findings.current: “I said I did a good job!”
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject of the praise: Jeok Cheongang is praising Jin Taekyung, not claiming that he himself did well.
findings.rationale: 잘했다고 has Jin Taekyung’s conduct as its contextually omitted subject, which is why the praise satisfies him in the following narration.

findings.current: “The junior has committed a discourtesy. However, given the circumstances…”
findings.defect: The Daoist’s humble first-person self-reference 후배 is rendered as though he were referring to a third party.
findings.rationale: 후배 is a formal, self-effacing reference to the speaker in relation to the senior Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: “This junior was discourteous. However, given the circumstances…”

findings.current: Older than this old man. She was also the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun’s only Senior Aunt.
findings.defect: The draft adds “only,” a quantity not stated in this passage.
findings.rationale: 사고 establishes the martial-family relationship but does not itself state that she was the sole Senior Aunt.
findings.replacement: Older than this old man. She was also the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun’s Senior Aunt.

findings.defect: The draft makes the question blunt and casual, losing the deliberately respectful euphemism 춘추 and Taekyung’s newly cautious manner.
findings.rationale: 춘추 is an honorific, indirect way of asking an elder’s age, particularly apt immediately after the warning to be careful about it.
findings.replacement: *Just how advanced in years is she?*

findings.current: “Good to meet you, Young Master Jin.”
findings.defect: The draft replaces the Buddhist form of address 시주 with the unrelated secular rank “Young Master.”
findings.rationale: As a Buddhist nun, the Extinction Divine Nun addresses Jin with 시주, preserving her religious voice rather than calling him 공자.

findings.current: The two Sect Leaders readily turned and started walking ahead.
findings.defect: The draft attaches “readily” to the Sect Leaders’ movement, whereas 흔쾌한 describes Taekyung’s willing answer.
findings.rationale: The source’s pragmatic cue characterizes Taekyung as agreeing without reluctance; it does not characterize how the Sect Leaders turn.
findings.replacement: At my ready agreement, the two Sect Leaders took the lead and started walking.
findings.source: 내 흔쾌한 대답에 두 장문인이 앞장서서 걸음을 떼는데,

findings.current: “According to the Three Fiends, whom we captured and interrogated, that appears to be the case.
findings.defect: The draft changes a singular reference to the captured Third Fiend into all three Fiends, falsely stating that the entire group was captured and interrogated.
findings.rationale: In this singular context 삼괴 refers to the Third Fiend, consistent with the established chapter-specific rendering and the known capture.
findings.replacement: “According to the Third Fiend, whom we captured and interrogated, that appears to be the case.
findings.source: 삼괴(三怪)를 붙잡아 심문한 바에 의하면 그렇다네.

findings.current: The Fire Gate Cavern on Mount Jiuhua had an impressive mystic formation installed inside it, but that didn’t mean we were experts.
findings.defect: The established formation terminology is replaced with a generic lowercase phrase, and “experts” is left without its intended field.
findings.rationale: 기문진식 invokes the established Mystic Gate Formation terminology, while 능통한 것은 아니다 refers specifically to their lack of formation expertise.
findings.replacement: The Fire Gate Cavern on Mount Jiuhua had a formidable Mystic Gate Formation installed inside it, but that didn’t mean we were experts in formations.
findings.source: 구화산의 열화동은 대단한 기문진식이 설치되어 있지만, 그렇다고 해서 우리가 능통한 것은 아니니까.

findings.defect: The draft narrows Taekyung’s statement to visual observations even though he was asked about both the man’s words and actions.
findings.rationale: 말씀드린 게 전부 means that everything he has already related is the full account, without limiting it to what he visually witnessed.

findings.current: *One of them regenerated like a human Troll, while another could take his arm off and stick it back on as though he had double-sided tape on it. And in the end, there was even possession.*
findings.defect: The draft explicitly assigns the regeneration and detachable-arm abilities to two different people, while the source leaves the subjects unstated.
findings.rationale: The source lists the bizarre abilities without identifying which individual performed each one, so the translation must preserve that ambiguity.
findings.replacement: *Regenerating like a human Troll, taking an arm off and sticking it back on as if it had double-sided tape on it—and finally, even possession.*
findings.source: ‘인간 트롤마냥 재생하지를 않나, 팔에 양면테이프라도 붙였는지 뗐다 붙이고. 마지막에는 빙의까지 했지.’

findings.current: “Before you woke up, we heard the general situation from Great Hero Jeok.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the Buddhist address 시주 with the martial title “Great Hero,” erasing the speaker’s religious register.
findings.rationale: The Buddhist speaker calls Jeok Cheongang 적 시주, not 적 대협; “Benefactor Jeok” preserves that distinction.
findings.replacement: “Before you woke up, we heard the general situation from Benefactor Jeok.
findings.source: “으음. 우선 자네가 깨어나기 전 적 시주에게 대략적인 상황은 모두 들었네.

summary: The draft contains two critical factual errors involving the subject of Jeok Cheongang’s praise and the number of captured Fiends, along with several meaningful register, attribution, and terminology issues.
